_comment: Claude Code CLI MCP server configuration template. After copying this example folder, rename to .mcp.json at the repo root (project scope, committed) or ~/.claude.json (user scope) and customize for your project. NOTE: this is the Claude Code CLI's MCP file, not the Claude Desktop app's claude_desktop_config.json. The default set is vendor-neutral; add proprietary servers only as your stack requires.

env._comment: Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in your shell profile or .env (gitignored). Do NOT hardcode it here.
